title: Step 3 - Implementing PCA and SVM for Customer Segmentation: Practical Guide

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So, in the previous tutorials, we took care of the pre-processing phase, and then we applied PCA on our data set to reduce its dimensionality down to two new extracted features,
cues.zh: 前幾堂完成資料前處理，再對資料集套用 PCA，將維度降為兩個新擷取特徵，

cues.en: and now we are ready to build a classification model.
cues.zh: 現在可以建立分類模型。

cues.en: So, speaking of classification model, we started with a logistic regression model, but actually from this point, we can build any classification model among all the classification models we made in part three.
cues.zh: 說到分類模型，原先從邏輯斯迴歸出發，但其實從這裡開始，可以用第三部分建立的任何分類模型。

cues.en: If I go back to part three, classification, this folder here, you have here all the models we made in this part three, and basically from this point, you can build any model you want
cues.zh: 回到 Part 3 Classification 這個資料夾，就有當時做過的全部模型，基本上從這裡開始，可以

cues.en: by just selecting your classification model.
cues.zh: 選擇任何想建立的分類模型。

cues.en: For example, let's take a support vector machine classification model.
cues.zh: 例如使用支援向量機分類模型。

cues.en: Then you can just open the SVMr file, and then basically, all you need to do is take everything after the data pre-processing phase,
cues.zh: 開啟 svm.R，基本上只要取出資料前處理之後的全部內容，

cues.en: that is from where you start to build your SVM model, and select everything down to the bottom and copy.
cues.zh: 也就是從開始建立 SVM 的地方，一路選到底，再複製。

cues.en: And then in your PCA file, you can include your classification model right after applying PCA on your data set.
cues.zh: 然後在 PCA 檔案裡，將分類模型放在套用 PCA 之後。

cues.en: And so here, I just replaced the logistic regression model by the SVM model.
cues.zh: 這裡就把邏輯斯迴歸換成 SVM。

cues.en: And you can do this for any classification model you want among the classification models we made in part three.
cues.zh: 對第三部分建立的任何分類模型，都可以這樣做。

cues.en: So that's very easy to replace your different models by this simple copy, paste so that you can try different classification models very efficiently.
cues.zh: 透過簡單的複製貼上就能替換模型，很有效率地嘗試不同分類模型。

cues.en: So, let's see what we get with this SVM model for example.
cues.zh: 例如看看 SVM 會得到什麼。

cues.en: We just need to change here the name of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 只要修改這裡的依變數名稱。

cues.en: This is not purchased, but customer segment.
cues.zh: 不再是 Purchased，而是 Customer_Segment。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And that's the only thing we need to change because the data here has input training set, and this is the training set which is transformed, the new training set composed of the new extracted features.
cues.zh: 這是唯一需要修改的地方，因為 data 的輸入是 training_set，而它已轉換為包含新擷取特徵的新訓練集。

cues.en: And so basically, we are ready to select this section, and execute it to build our SVM classification model.
cues.zh: 基本上可以選取這段並執行，建立 SVM 分類模型。

cues.en: And now that the model is built, we are ready to predict the new observations of the test set, and so this line is ready.
cues.zh: 模型建立後，就能預測測試集的新觀測資料，這一行也準備好了。

cues.en: And actually, we don't need to change anything because this index three here is the index of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 其實不必修改，因為這裡的索引 3，代表依變數索引。

cues.en: And since we reduced the dimensionality of our data set down to two, that means that we have two features, and one dependent variable, and therefore the index of the dependent variable is still three.
cues.zh: 資料集維度降為 2，表示有兩個特徵和一個依變數，所以依變數索引仍是 3。

cues.en: And so, we are ready to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行並執行。

cues.en: And now we have the predictions of the test set results.
cues.zh: 現在取得測試集結果的預測。

cues.en: So, we can have a look.
cues.zh: 可以看看。

cues.en: Y grid, in the council, press Enter.
cues.zh: 在主控台輸入 y_pred，按 Enter。

cues.en: And for each observation of the test set, we have its prediction by the model, the SVM model.
cues.zh: 每筆測試觀測資料，都有 SVM 模型對它的預測。

cues.en: So for example, the fourth line of the data set that belongs to the test set is predicted to belong to customer number one, and the one number 132
cues.zh: 例如資料集第 4 列屬於測試集，預測屬於顧客區隔 1；第 132 列，

cues.en: is predicted to belong to customer segment number three.
cues.zh: 預測屬於顧客區隔 3。

cues.en: So very easy and now we can make the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 很簡單，接著建立混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And same, we don't need to change anything here because this corresponds to the index of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 同樣不需要修改，因為這裡對應依變數索引。

cues.en: So, we are ready to execute this as well.
cues.zh: 這段也可以直接執行。

cues.en: Execute.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: The confusion matrix is ready, let's have a look.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣準備好了，看看。

cues.en: And wow, perfect results.
cues.zh: 哇，結果完美。

cues.en: We only get correct predictions.
cues.zh: 全部預測正確。

cues.en: As you can see, 12 ones were correctly predicted to belong to customer segment number one.
cues.zh: 可以看到，12 筆正確預測屬於顧客區隔 1。

cues.en: 14 ones were correctly predicted to belong to customer segment number two, and 10 ones were correctly predicted to belong to customer segment number three.
cues.zh: 14 筆正確預測屬於顧客區隔 2，10 筆正確預測屬於顧客區隔 3。

cues.en: And then we have zero incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 錯誤預測則是 0。

cues.en: So, these are excellent results, and of course we get 100% accuracy.
cues.zh: 結果非常好，準確率當然是 100%。

cues.en: So, now when moving on the next part to visualize the training set results, we should get amazingly well-separated prediction regions, and a very clear prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 因此下一部分視覺化訓練集結果時，應該會得到分隔得很好的預測區域，以及清楚的決策邊界。

cues.en: So, let's shake it out.
cues.zh: 來確認一下。

cues.en: But now we have something to change, and this is not a tiny change as we used to do because now we have three classes.
cues.zh: 不過現在有內容需要修改，而且不像以前只是小改，因為這次有三個類別。

cues.en: And as you can notice in this code, when we plot the prediction regions, thanks to this line, well this code template allows us to do it when we only have two classes because as you can see,
cues.zh: 可以注意到，這段程式碼透過這一行畫出預測區域，但範本只適用於兩個類別，因為

cues.en: we have this if/else condition.
cues.zh: 使用了 ifelse 條件。

cues.en: If Y grid equals one, then the color is green and else if Y grid equals zero, then the color is tomato.
cues.zh: 如果 y_grid 等於 1，顏色是綠色；否則 y_grid 等於 0，顏色是 tomato。

cues.en: And same when we plot the observations, if the observations of the set, that is the training set belongs to class one, then it's a green, and if it belongs to class zero,
cues.zh: 畫觀測資料也一樣，如果 set，也就是訓練集的觀測資料屬於第 1 類，就用綠色；屬於第 0 類，

cues.en: that is in the else condition, the point will be red.
cues.zh: 也就是 else 的情況，資料點就是紅色。

cues.en: But now the problem is that we have three classes so we need to improve this code here to distinct the three conditions;
cues.zh: 現在問題是有三個類別，所以要改進程式碼，區分三種條件，

cues.en: if Y equals zero, if Y equals one, and if Y equals two.
cues.zh: 也就是 y 等於 0、1、2。

cues.en: So let's do it, that will be good coding practice.
cues.zh: 來做吧，這是很好的程式練習。

cues.en: And speaking of coding practice, what would be very good is that you try to do it before I do it in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 說到練習，很建議你在我示範之前，先試著自己做。

cues.en: So, you can press pause and try and now I'm gonna do it.
cues.zh: 可以暫停影片先試，現在我來示範。

cues.en: So, basically we need to add one more condition, the condition where Y equals two.
cues.zh: 基本上要多加一個條件，也就是 y 等於 2。

cues.en: So, let's do it, let's add this new condition here.
cues.zh: 在這裡加入新條件。

cues.en: If Y grid equals equals two, then comma, and then after this condition, Y grid is equal to two,
cues.zh: 如果 y_grid == 2，再加逗號，在 y_grid 等於 2 這個條件之後，

cues.en: we will put what we want.
cues.zh: 放入想要的結果。

cues.en: And what we want is a new color because there is one color associated to each value of Y grid.
cues.zh: 我們要新的顏色，因為 y_grid 的每個值，都對應一種顏色。

cues.en: So, we will keep spring green three for the case where y grid equals one, and we will keep tomato for the case where Y grid equals zero.
cues.zh: 所以 y_grid 等於 1 時，保留 springgreen3；等於 0 時，保留 tomato。

cues.en: But for Y grid equals two, we need to introduce a new color.
cues.zh: 但 y_grid 等於 2，需要加入新顏色。

cues.en: And since we have here green and red, let's put blue.
cues.zh: 既然已有綠與紅，就用藍色。

cues.en: So, a good color is actually deep sky blue, then comma to get the next conditions.
cues.zh: 不錯的顏色是 deepskyblue，再加逗號，接後面的條件。

cues.en: So, so far what we see is that if Y grid equals equals two, then the color will be deep sky blue.
cues.zh: 目前看到，如果 y_grid == 2，顏色就是 deepskyblue。

cues.en: Then if Y grid equals one, then the color will be green, and if Y grid equals zero, then the color will be red.
cues.zh: 如果 y_grid 等於 1，就是綠色；等於 0，就是紅色。

cues.en: But this is not how it works, it's not as simple as that because this is actually not a correct syntax because this if/else function expects three arguments.
cues.zh: 但實際上不能這樣寫，沒這麼直接，因為語法不正確，ifelse 函式只接受三個參數。

cues.en: The first argument is the condition, Y grid equal one, then the second argument is the result when this condition is true, and the third argument is the result
cues.zh: 第一個是條件，y_grid 等於 1；第二個是條件為真時的結果；第三個是條件

cues.en: when this condition is not true.
cues.zh: 不為真時的結果。

cues.en: So, here we have a lot more than three arguments, so that's not right.
cues.zh: 現在這裡超過三個參數，所以不對。

cues.en: And so the trick to solve this is to put all this, that is the Y grid equals one condition, and then the result, spring green three,
cues.zh: 解法是把這整段，也就是 y_grid 等於 1 的條件、結果 springgreen3，

cues.en: and then the result if Y grid equals zero into the third argument of this if/else function.
cues.zh: 以及 y_grid 等於 0 的結果，全部放進 ifelse 的第三個參數。

cues.en: So, that means that we'll get the first argument, Y grid equals two, that's the condition, then the second argument, deep sky blue, that is the result when Y grid equals two.
cues.zh: 也就是第一個參數為條件 y_grid 等於 2；第二個參數為 deepskyblue，是條件成立時的結果。

cues.en: And the third argument all this in one same argument.
cues.zh: 第三個參數則把剩下這段視為單一參數。

cues.en: And so how can we include all this in one same argument?
cues.zh: 如何將它們放進同一個參數？

cues.en: Well, we need to use another if/else here, which will contain the other two conditions where Y grid equals one and Y grid equals zero.
cues.zh: 需要在這裡再使用一個 ifelse，包含 y_grid 等於 1 與等於 0 的另外兩種情況。

cues.en: And so, we need to be careful with the parenthesis because we added a new function, this new function if/else.
cues.zh: 因此要注意括號，因為多加入一個 ifelse 函式。

cues.en: And here it is, the new parenthesis is added and now it should be fine.
cues.zh: 這裡補上新的括號，現在應該沒問題。

cues.en: So, let's recap.
cues.zh: 複習一下。

cues.en: We start with this first if/else here.
cues.zh: 先從第一個 ifelse 開始。

cues.en: So, if Y grid equals two, then the color will be deep sky blue.
cues.zh: y_grid 等於 2，顏色就是 deepskyblue。

cues.en: And then if Y grid is not equal to two, then we go into this new if/else, and this new if/else contains the two less remaining conditions.
cues.zh: 如果 y_grid 不等於 2，就進入新的 ifelse，它包含剩下兩種情況。

cues.en: That is, if Y grid equals one, then the color will be spring green three, and if Y grid equals zero, then the color will be tomato, like red.
cues.zh: 也就是 y_grid 等於 1 時，顏色是 springgreen3；等於 0 時，是 tomato，也就是紅色。

cues.en: And therefore, we get our three conditions in the correct syntax.
cues.zh: 因此三種條件都有了，語法也正確。

cues.en: So, that's the trick.
cues.zh: 這就是技巧。

cues.en: It's actually quite common to do it in coding, so it's good to know how to do it.
cues.zh: 寫程式時其實很常見，所以值得學會。

cues.en: And that's the same to plot the colors of our observation points.
cues.zh: 繪製觀測點顏色也是一樣。

cues.en: So, we need to take this and paste it here again and then replace this one here by two.
cues.zh: 取用這段，貼到這裡，再把這個 1 換成 2。

cues.en: So, that is the new first condition.
cues.zh: 這就是新的第一個條件。

cues.en: If our observation point belongs to class two, then we want to give it a new color, which will be a blue color, but a different blue than this deep sky blue.
cues.zh: 如果觀測點屬於第 2 類，就指定新顏色，也是藍色，但和 deepskyblue 不同。

cues.en: And so, we need to get a good contrast so that we don't confuse the color of the point and the color of the region.
cues.zh: 需要足夠對比，避免混淆資料點與區域顏色。

cues.en: So, actually a good color to use here is blue three.
cues.zh: 這裡不錯的選擇是 blue3。

cues.en: Blue three, you'll see that it'll give us a good contrast.
cues.zh: blue3，你會看到對比很清楚。

cues.en: And so, that's the first result of the first condition.
cues.zh: 這就是第一個條件對應的結果。

cues.en: And then same, we need to include the two remaining conditions here into one argument that is inside a new if/else.
cues.zh: 同樣，剩下兩種條件需要合併為單一參數，放在新的 ifelse 裡。

cues.en: So, if/else here and parenthesis, and we don't forget to add the closing parenthesis here and here we go, this is ready.
cues.zh: 加上 ifelse 與括號，也別忘記在這裡補上右括號，好了。

cues.en: So, recap again.
cues.zh: 再複習一次。

cues.en: If our observation point belongs to class two, then it will have the color blue three, then if it doesn't belong to class two, then we go here.
cues.zh: 觀測點屬於第 2 類，就用 blue3；否則進入這裡。

cues.en: And here, we have two new separate conditions.
cues.zh: 這裡又有兩個不同條件。

cues.en: If our observation points belongs to class one, then it will have the color green four, and if it doesn't belong to class one, then it will have the color red three.
cues.zh: 觀測點屬於第 1 類，用 green4；否則用 red3。

cues.en: So, that should be ready, and then we have the tiny changes to add.
cues.zh: 這樣應該準備好了，接著還有幾個小修改。

cues.en: So, remember in this line here, line 49 with the column names, we need to input the real column names of the columns of the training set.
cues.zh: 記得第 49 行的 colnames，必須輸入訓練集實際欄位名稱。

cues.en: And these column names are not age and estimated salary, that was for the previous classification problem.
cues.zh: 名稱不再是 Age 與 EstimatedSalary，那是先前的分類問題。

cues.en: Now the column names are of course PC one and PC two.
cues.zh: 現在欄名當然是 PC1 與 PC2。

cues.en: So here, we just need to replace age by PC one and estimated salary by PC two.
cues.zh: 所以把 Age 換成 PC1，EstimatedSalary 換成 PC2。

cues.en: So that's compulsory, that's actually what you need to input.
cues.zh: 這是必要的，必須正確輸入。

cues.en: Otherwise, you will get an error when you execute your code.
cues.zh: 否則執行程式時會出錯。

cues.en: And then here, that's not compulsory, but it's better for the visualization.
cues.zh: 接著這裡不是必要修改，但改了視覺效果更好。

cues.en: You can replace age by PC one, and estimated salary by PC two.
cues.zh: 把 Age 換成 PC1，EstimatedSalary 換成 PC2。

cues.en: But if you don't do it, you will not get an error because this is just for the visualization.
cues.zh: 不改也不會出錯，因為這裡只影響視覺化。

cues.en: This is just for the labels that you will see on the graph.
cues.zh: 只是圖上的軸標籤。

cues.en: All right, and then I think we're good.
cues.zh: 好，我想都沒問題了。

cues.en: I think this is ready to be executed.
cues.zh: 應該可以執行。

cues.en: Let's hope that I didn't make any mistake.
cues.zh: 希望沒有打錯。

cues.en: So, we are gonna try to execute this and let's see what we get.
cues.zh: 試著執行，看看結果。

cues.en: So, I'm going to select everything in this section.
cues.zh: 選取這個區段的全部內容。

cues.en: So, from here up to the top here, and let's execute.
cues.zh: 從這裡到上方，接著執行。

cues.en: All right, good start, it's running.
cues.zh: 好，開始得不錯，正在執行。

cues.en: Let's see what we get, let's go into this plot tab.
cues.zh: 看看結果，切到 Plots 分頁。

cues.en: It is still running, and here we go.
cues.zh: 還在執行，好，出來了。

cues.en: We get our beautiful results.
cues.zh: 得到漂亮的結果。

cues.en: So, I hope you like my choice of the colors.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡我選的顏色。

cues.en: This is the deep sky blue and this is the blue three, so that we get the contrast between the observation points and the prediction regions.
cues.zh: 這是 deepskyblue，這是 blue3，所以觀測資料點與預測區域有足夠對比。

cues.en: So, we can actually enlarge this if you want.
cues.zh: 想的話可以再放大。

cues.en: So, as a quick reminder, the points are the real observation points.
cues.zh: 快速提醒，資料點是實際觀測資料。

cues.zh: 其實可以取用上面兩行，複製，選取這裡，再貼上。

cues.zh: 可以這樣做，是因為變數名稱和訓練集相同，兩者都使用這個 set 變數，

cues.zh: 基本上都準備好了，現在可以選取整個區段執行，視覺化測試集結果。
